description: List the authenticated user's enrichment sheets. Returns each exact sheet id, name, people/company mode, row count, and referenceable columns. Read-only. Every sheet takes people and companies; mode is ignored. Each sheet comes with how many people and how many companies without a person it holds (content).

mode.description: Optionally return only people sheets or only company sheets.
